title: Challenge 2.3: Intelligent System Diagnostic Router
description: Build a complete diagnostic routing system using IF, ELSE IF, ELSE, comparison operators, and boolean logic.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, final test for control flow. Build an intelligent diagnostic router that makes complex decisions based on multiple system parameters."
story.context: This challenge combines all IF concepts: basic IF, ELSE IF chains, ELSE fallback, comparison operators, AND/OR logic. Real-world decision-making!
story.success: MENTOR-9: "EXCEPTIONAL! You've built a production-grade decision engine. This is how real test automation handles complex scenarios!"

instructions: Create the *** Test Cases *** section with test: 'Diagnostic Router'
Build decision tree with IF...ELSE IF...ELSE:
Log: 'CRITICAL: Power depleted, no backup - emergency shutdown required'
Log: 'DANGER: High temperature with sensor failure - activate emergency cooling'
Log: 'OPTIMAL: All systems within acceptable parameters'
Note: Complex boolean logic + multi-level ELSE IF + complete coverage
hints: Use 'and' to require both conditions TRUE
Use 'or' to require at least one TRUE
solution:
*** Test Cases ***
Diagnostic Router
    ${power}=    Set Variable    55
    ${temp}=    Set Variable    78
    ${sensors}=    Set Variable    degraded
    ${backup}=    Set Variable    available
    IF    ${power} < 20 and ${backup} != 'available'
        Log    CRITICAL: Power depleted, no backup - emergency shutdown required
    ELSE IF    ${temp} > 85 and ${sensors} == 'failed'
        Log    DANGER: High temperature with sensor failure - activate emergency cooling
    ELSE IF    ${power} >= 50 and ${temp} < 80
        Log    OPTIMAL: All systems within acceptable parameters
    ELSE IF    ${sensors} == 'degraded' or ${power} < 50
        Log    WARNING: Degraded performance - recommend maintenance
    ELSE
        Log    UNKNOWN STATUS: Manual inspection required
    END

theory.title: Challenge 2.3: Diagnostic Router
theory.content:
🎯 The Master Decision Engine

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, this is it. Everything you've learned: IF basics, ELSE IF chains, comparison operators, boolean AND/OR logic - all combined into one intelligent router."

"Four variables, five decision paths, complex logic. This is professional-grade test automation."

🧠 Challenge Requirements

You Must Demonstrate:

  • ✅ Boolean AND - Combine conditions (both must be TRUE)
  • ✅ Boolean OR - Alternative conditions (one must be TRUE)
  • ✅ Comparison operators - <, >, ==, !=, <=, >=
  • ✅ ELSE IF chain - Multiple sequential checks
  • ✅ ELSE fallback - Catch unmatched cases
  • ✅ Complex logic - Real-world decision tree

📝 Expected Decision Flow

Input: power=55, temp=78, sensors='degraded', backup='available'

1. IF power<20 AND backup!='available' → FALSE (55 not <20)
2. ELSE IF temp>85 AND sensors=='failed' → FALSE (78 not >85)
3. ELSE IF power>=50 AND temp<80 → FALSE (78 not <80) [close!]
4. ELSE IF sensors=='degraded' OR power<50 → TRUE! ✓
   → Log: WARNING: Degraded performance...
5. (ELSE never reached)

🏅 Success Criteria

  • 🔹 4 variables: power, temp, sensors, backup
  • 🔹 5 decision paths: IF + 3 ELSE IF + ELSE
  • 🔹 Complex conditions: Use AND and OR
  • 🔹 All operators: <, >, ==, !=, >=
  • 🔹 Complete coverage: Every scenario handled

🎯 Your Challenge

Build the complete diagnostic router! Route system status through complex decision tree to correct action. This is your IF statement mastery test!
